ai.title: Free mode pins Base2 to Fireworks provider
ai.summary: Base2 agent now restricts free mode to the Fireworks provider via `providerOptions.only`, `order`, and `allow_fallbacks: false`. This ensures deterministic routing for the `minimax/minimax-m2.5` model and denies data collection. Paid mode remains unaffected, continuing to use `anthropic/claude-opus-4.6` with default provider routing.

eli5.text: When you use the free tier of the Base2 agent, your requests are now always sent to the Fireworks provider instead of potentially bouncing among different providers. This locks the free path to one specific model routing, which also blocks that provider from collecting data about your usage. If you pay for access, nothing changes for you: you still get the default provider selection and the Claude Opus model, exactly as before. The change is live today for anyone using the Base2 agent under the free tier.
